payload.instruction: Put a frog in the toilet
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Are the toilet bowl and its contents sufficiently visible to assess frog placement, and what frog locations are visibly distinguishable?
node.criteria: Pass if the bowl and relevant contents are assessable; fail only if they are clearly visible and establish no frog within the bowl; unknown if visibility or evidence is insufficient. State whether frogs are visible in the bowl, on the lid/tank, or on the floor, distinguishing these locations; this check supplies evidence only and does not decide fulfillment.
node.binding: Use the edited image and source toilet to assess visibility and report observable locations separately. Do not conflate a frog on the lid or tank with one in the bowl, and do not infer an empty bowl from uncertainty.

dependencies.evidence: A recognizable green frog is visibly inside the toilet bowl opening, seated in the bowl interior. Other frogs are also visible on the raised lid and on the floor beside the toilet, but the bowl frog is clearly within the bowl.

response.content: {"status":"pass","evidence":"The toilet bowl and its contents are clearly visible. A frog is visibly inside the bowl; separate frogs are also visible on the raised lid and on the floor beside the toilet.","confidence":0.99,"used_dependency_ids":["s1"]}
